scope: Egypt medical discovery — Cairo University Faculty of Medicine (Kasr Al Ainy)

verifiedFacts.claim: The Cairo Faculty of Medicine international-student office directs Bachelor of Medicine and General Surgery applicants to the Study in Egypt platform and provides international-student support information.

Cairo University's Faculty of Medicine lists separate mainstream and integrated-programme foreign-student routes through the Expatriates Department and Expatriates Coordination; IPKA applicants must pass an English examination and personal interview.
Egypt's National Qualifications Framework lists Cairo University's Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery as English, face-to-face and full-time, with a six-year minimum duration.
The same regulator record marks the programme accredited by NAQAAE from 14 May 2024 to 14 May 2029.

holdReasons: No current official tuition schedule for the foreign mainstream or IPKA Medicine cohort was found. The faculty says fees are paid after final acceptance but gives no amount.
The available sources describe more than one foreign route, but do not establish one aligned 2026/27 package of tuition, requirements, start date and course structure for a single catalogue offering.

The regulator record is strong recognition evidence, but its programme record lists an end-of-operation date in 2024 despite accreditation through 2029; this apparent date conflict requires regulator clarification before using it as a current programme status.
No authoritative current source was found for a complete programme-specific accommodation/living-cost evidence bundle.
nextAction: Obtain a 2026/27 Cairo University or Study in Egypt foreign-Medicine fee notice and a written confirmation identifying the applicable foreign route, intake/start date and current regulator-record status.
